New services must use **`gateway-api`**. The deciding file is [`policy/ingress-class/v3.yaml`](https://github.com/dshnayder-org/infra/blob/git-access-ab/r200/policy/ingress-class/v3.yaml) in `dshnayder-org/infra` on branch `git-access-ab/r200`.

## The mandate, verbatim

From `policy/ingress-class/v3.yaml`:

```
# policy: ingress-class
# version: v3   effective: 2026-04-19   status: current
# subject: which ingress implementation new services must use
apiVersion: policy.meridian.io/v1
kind: FleetPolicy
metadata:
  name: ingress-class-v3
spec:
  effectiveFrom: 2026-04-19
  status: current
  setting: gateway-api
```
